name: scvi_tools
description: scvi-tools is a third-party probabilistic modeling tool primitive for single-cell batch correction, transfer learning, multimodal integration, uncertainty-aware differential expression, and related generative models. Use it when a Scanpy-style workflow needs learned latent representations or model-based integration rather than only exploratory preprocessing.
capabilities: Train scVI-family models on raw-count AnnData or MuData inputs.
Produce latent representations, denoised expression, and label-transfer outputs.
Support multimodal integration, spatial deconvolution, and RNA velocity-adjacent models where applicable.
Expose uncertainty-aware downstream analysis for cell states and differential expression.
requirements: Python environment with scvi-tools, PyTorch, and anndata installed.
Raw count inputs and model-specific covariates or modality registration.
GPU optional, but helpful for large models.
